**Description**
 The Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is Amazon’s 24/7 centralized command center supporting Worldwide Amazon Stores. The GSOC manages critical incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and brand reputation by connecting sites with the appropriate subject matter experts and coordinating end\-to\-end incident response. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.
   

  

 The Security Operations Manager, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) will provides critical support and timely notification to global partners regarding incidents that have impacted, or have the potential to impact, Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand. They will assist in managerial ownership of their shift and be responsible for ensuring performance SLAs are met, that responses are appropriate according to policies and procedures, and for developing and motivating a highly performant staff. The Security Operations Manager must also deal effectively with ambiguity and make response\-related decisions sometimes with incomplete information in the best interest of Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate elevated judgment while operating under pressure. They must possess the ability to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles to identify barriers and initiate actions to resolve. The candidate should possess a proven record of working across multiple organizations to resolve escalations where the problem and solutions, as well as risk strategy, may not be well defined.
   

  

 The GSOC is a 24/7/365 operation, and this position will require shift work, including night and weekend shifts.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead 24/7 GSOC shift operations, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and Amazon’s brand.
* Provide timely notifications, situation reports, and executive briefings to global stakeholders
* Ensure shift operational excellence by maintaining ownership of performance, achieving established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and driving consistent execution of policies and procedures
* Partner with Security, Operations, HR, Workplace Health \& Safety (WHS), Legal, Communications and other internal stakeholders to coordinate effective incident response and business continuity support.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Operations Security Specialists by setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and feedback, and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
* Monitor incident trends, operational metrics, and emerging risks to identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen response capabilities, and reduce recurring issues.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience, standardize best practices, and enhance the effectiveness of global incident management.
* Partner with cross\-functional and global teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve processes, tools, and operational standards that support scalable, efficient GSOC operations.
* Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, and customer obsession while protecting Amazon’s associates, operations, and brand.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a GSOC Security Operations Manager, you will lead a team responsible for managing critical security and operational incidents across Amazon’s global network. Your day may include directing responses to workplace emergencies, severe weather events, security threats, transportation incidents, or operational disruptions while coordinating with multiple business partners and executive stakeholders. You will coach your team in real time, provide strategic guidance during escalations, ensure operational metrics are met, and continuously improve processes that strengthen Amazon’s global incident management capability.

 HR \& Finance Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \& Finance
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Information Technology \& Services, Artificial Intelligence, Critical Infrastructure
 



  





**About Company** 




 A research\-first AI company incubated at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc). It builds advanced AI for the planning and operations of critical networks.
 



 Its core technology is a World Model that augments LLMs to reason about network state and dependencies — even with incomplete information. The founding team has raised over $100M in prior ventures and published at leading AI research venues.
 



 The company has just closed its seed round and is at the zero\-to\-one stage of building.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a hands\-on, dual\-function role that builds and runs the people and finance backbone of the company. Reporting directly to the founders, you will independently own HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance, and day\-to\-day accounting — creating the systems and processes that let the technical team focus on frontier AI. At a company of this stage, you won't inherit a playbook; you'll write it.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, records management, leave/attendance tracking, and offboarding — ensuring a seamless experience at every stage.
* Process monthly payroll accurately and on time; manage all statutory filings and compliance for PF, ESI, PT, and TDS without exception.
* Maintain books of accounts in Tally — covering invoicing, vendor bills, accounts payable/receivable, and monthly bank reconciliations.
* Support monthly MIS preparation, cash\-flow tracking, budgeting inputs, GST filings, and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Coordinate recruitment logistics, HR policy rollout, performance management tracking, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage office administration, vendor contracts, and relationships with external stakeholders including legal teams, banks, and the Company Secretary.
* Build scalable HR and finance systems and documentation (policy guidebooks, trackers, SOPs) in partnership with the founders.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2–6 years of experience in an HR generalist or HR operations role with direct exposure to finance and accounts.
* Hands\-on working knowledge of Tally for day\-to\-day bookkeeping — invoicing, AP/AR, and bank reconciliations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently process payroll and manage statutory compliance filings: PF, ESI, PT, and TDS.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* Prior experience setting up or maintaining HR systems — attendance/leave trackers, onboarding/offboarding workflows, and compliance records — in a lean team environment.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* M.Com or MBA (HR or Finance) preferred.
* Prior experience in a startup or early\-stage company where you operated across both HR and finance functions simultaneously.
* Familiarity with GST filing processes and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Exposure to building HR/finance documentation from scratch — policy guidebooks, SOPs, or process playbooks.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct access and reporting line to the founders — high visibility and influence over how the company is built.
* Opportunity to design and own the people and finance function from the ground up at a seed\-stage, IISc\-incubated AI company.
* Work at the intersection of frontier AI and critical infrastructure — a mission with long\-term national and global significance.
* Lean, high\-ownership environment where your work has immediate, measurable impact on the organisation.
